purpose: Thirteenth unmapped quality-first reserve dedicated to finance and money systems: bank credit creation and fiat money; stock-market microstructure, dark pools and high-frequency trading; money laundering and shadow finance; crypto/blockchain/meme coins/prediction markets/Ponzi dynamics; and alternative currencies, mutual credit and exchange networks.
sourcePolicy: Research reserve only. Separate monetary mechanism from rhetoric: bank-deposit creation is not free wealth; fiat value is not the same question as legal tender; market speed is not itself manipulation; privacy technology is not itself laundering; speculative price dependence is not automatically a Ponzi scheme; decentralized systems still have concrete trust and governance surfaces.
mappingPolicy: UNMAPPED_BY_DESIGN. Do not invent deck/card/island/billboard/world/multiverse assignments during collection.

rotationIntent.goal: Add mechanism-level financial literacy and market-structure material so later KFB finance, shadow-power, casino-market, crypto, consumer and alternative-economy worlds can contrast how money is issued, prices are formed, ownership is hidden, speculation propagates, and exchange networks are designed.
rotationIntent.note: No financial advice, runtime selector, truth classifier, mapping or public approval is changed in this research slice.
